name: corhazi-courier-without-the-class-bonus-on-hit-does-not-draw
notes: Generated bodies gated these cards' [Class Bonus] with IsClassBonusActive($player) and NO class list, which only checks that the player controls any champion and is therefore always true: every champion got the bonus. IsClassBonusActive() now resolves the bare form against the printed class(es) of the card whose ability closure is running (GAInstallClassBonusSourceWrappers() in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php wraps the 32 affected cards' ability closures); a champion matching any of the card's classes satisfies it. Spirit of Fire is not an Assassin: no On Hit draw/discard.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Hit: Draw a card, then discard a card. If a fire element card was discarded, choose a unit and deal 1 damage to it.

engineBug.summary: Class Bonus effects applied for every champion (bare IsClassBonusActive($player) is always true).
